steps.statement: The DFS stops growing a branch once it has at least eight ideals; such a branch already disproves the desired upper bound.
Thus each base CNF is satisfiable **exactly when its colour class contains a union-and-intersection-closed family of at least nine sets**.
Every weighted poset has such a linear extension and appears in this enumeration.
Together with the lemma this proves f(13)≥8 for arbitrary colourings, independently of the published lower-bound proof.
Every finite poset has a linear extension, hence a natural labelling generated by this scheme.
